title: IsolationProof
description: What an isolation probe observed inside an evidence run's wrapper (docs/design/m0/12 "Content"). The probe runs in the same wrapper as the run, so it names the run. An evidence result is published only with a proof that proves its isolation (internal/evidence CheckIsolation): the run is the result's attempt's run, the setting is not empty, and the probe saw loopback only and could not reach the host. graph.CommitEvidence records any other result as could_not_run/isolation_unproven, and the result.recorded fold refuses a published one.

run.description: The run whose wrapper the probe ran in (05: the attempt's id under run_).

setting.description: The wrapper's isolation setting as it applied it, by option. {} is an empty setting: it is never published.

interfaces.description: The network interfaces the probe saw.

host_reachable.description: Whether the probe connected to an address the host can reach.
